title: True action finds the inward door
summary: The inward door opens as other hopes are abandoned for the One Shabad. True action begins by helping the gaze turn toward the One.
takeaway: Trade scattered hopes for the One Shabad that lets the heart behold.
lifeApplication: Release one lesser hope you keep feeding, then give that attention to Shabad, praise, or guiding someone toward steadier sight.

source.shortMeaning: Contemplating the One Shabad means abandoning other hopes and becoming someone who helps others behold.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking about vision again, let the One Shabad gather your hope and action.

evidence.coreClaim: Contemplating the One Shabad means abandoning other hopes and becoming someone who helps others behold.
evidence.turn: True action is not noise; it is hope gathered into the Shabad until sight can be shared.
evidence.practicalImplication: Release one lesser hope you keep feeding, then give that attention to Shabad, praise, or guiding someone toward steadier sight.
